1.h4 f5 2.e4 fxe4 3.d3.strategy: Attacks the e4 pawn and opens the c1-bishop's diagonal, the point of the gambit: White hopes quick development will cost Black more than the extra pawn is worth. Black can hold the pawn, so White needs the initiative to make it pay.
1.h4 f5 2.e4 fxe4 3.d3.name: Kádas Opening: Steinbok Gambit
